title: Next 30 years a danger time in the Taurid stream

tellings.quote: scientists from the comet research group he points that out that the next 30 years are a danger time

plain: The next 30 years are said to be a danger period for Earth as it passes through the Taurid stream, a band of comet debris our planet crosses every year. The writer Graham Hancock tells Michels this, passing on a warning from the Comet Research Group, a team of scientists that includes a researcher named Allen West. If they are right, it would mean the risk of a damaging impact from that debris is higher than usual for decades.
